d5m1-l1.lead: A lawsuit is a **highly structured, court-mandated process**: miss a deadline or misfile a document, and the court can dismiss the case.

concepts.text: Pleadings: track service and draft files; discovery: gather data, prep the client; trial prep: **coordinate schedules, final medicals**
more: The Complaint's five parts: caption, jurisdiction, facts, causes of action, prayer for relief
Atty. Thorne drafts it; before signature, verify **the filing date against the SOL**
Confirm the defendant's exact legal name from an independent record; a business: its registered agent
Log every service attempt; unserved at day 14, escalate to Atty. Thorne for Skip-Trace authority

concepts.text: Once suit is filed, paperwork stops being admin tracking: a **missing or misfiled document** can jeopardize the trial
Interrogatories are written questions under oath, RFPs demand documents, RFAs demand admit or deny: all **run on strict deadlines**
more: Interrogatories: John Doe answers under oath and signs the verification page
RFPs: you compile what they ask for; Atty. Thorne reviews and redacts
RFAs, the danger zone: one not answered in time **may be deemed admitted**
Never mail John Doe the 70 requests: book a 60-minute Discovery Intake Meeting

concepts.text: Every filing by either side creates a docket entry, and **its clock runs** whether or not the email reached you
more: File and docket everything from the court, opposing counsel or the server within 48 hours
Write the trigger, the method of service and **the arithmetic** into every entry
Never count the trigger day as day one; a weekend deadline rolls to Monday
Check the docket weekly, never only the e-filing emails: a motion lost in spam still runs
Unsure of the rule? Calendar the conservative date and confirm it

concepts.text: Both sides must lay their cards on the table; it is where Case Managers spend **most of their litigation time**
An oral interview under oath, recorded by a court reporter; you own **the logistics, not the testimony**

more: Rerun from every provider; never copy the pre-lit Demand Package
Run it before expert disclosure, 03/15/2027, and **again before pretrial**, 08/12/2027
Trial binders are built from these records, indexed and tabbed

d5m2-l1.lead: Property Damage is **a cornerstone of civil litigation**: the law's mechanism for making an owner financially whole after negligence harms their property.

concepts.text: In suit, PD can be **definitive evidence of injury** or the defense's most formidable tool against it
more: The $2,315.00 teardown supplement, 03/02/2026, is structural: the A-pillar
Hidden damage for the PD claim, **force for the injury claim**
No car until the 02/18/2026 rental: the first reason for the 14-Day Gap
Keep the loss-of-use and gap records identical, date for date

concepts.text: Special damages are quantifiable losses; general damages are subjective. Every PD figure is special, **proved by documents**
How much the defendant owes is among the **most heavily litigated** PD questions, so courts apply set formulas
more: Loss of Use: each day without the car or a paid substitute, priced at a comparable rental
Keystone's own $42.00/day rental rate is **the strongest measure**
Allocate the 78 days once: 12 without a car, 30 paid rental, 36 without a car
Claim only the 48 unpaid days: 48 × $42.00 = $2,016.00
Keystone's 30-day rental cap is claims practice; arguing the 36 days is Atty. Thorne's

concepts.text: Pre-loss market value minus post-loss value; the **lesser-of rule** weighs it against repair cost, capping a Total Loss
more: $9,255.00 is 52.6% of the $17,600.00 ACV, under Keystone's 75% line of $13,200.00
Repairable, with **$3,945.00 to spare**
Verify the Valuation Report: a low ACV moves the line
Confirm Keystone's threshold basis in writing

framework.title: Types of Damages You Can Recover
head: Type of damage
What it covers
On a PD claim
rows: Economic (special)
Quantifiable financial losses, **proved by documents**
Repair, tow and storage, rental, Loss of Use, Diminished Value
Non-economic (general)
Subjective losses: pain and suffering, emotional distress, loss of consortium
Claimed on the injury side, not the property side
Punitive (exemplary)
Punishes egregious, reckless or intentional misconduct and deters others
Conduct such as DUI; none is pleaded on this file
framework.note: The goal is not a windfall: restore the owner to the financial position held before the incident.

d5m2-l2.lead: The law measures property at **fair market value**, so what a repaired car still loses is a market loss, proved with market evidence.

concepts.text: Standard law values property at market; special value to an owner is **an exception, not the rule**
A carrier formula is claims practice, **not a legal measure**; an appraisal built on market data tests it
more: The 10% base caps it at $1,760.00, **however severe the damage**
0.75 is a tier below the top; the A-pillar teardown supports arguing 1.00, Atty. Thorne's call
0.60 discounts 52,300 miles the ACV already priced: mileage counted twice
The appraisal's $3,600.00 is 20.5% of ACV, more than twice the formula's ceiling
Audit the 05/06/2026 appraisal too: its method, data and credentials

concepts.text: Get the carrier's position and inputs in writing: only **a basis on paper** can be answered with stronger evidence
more: Ask Atty. Thorne how to get the 17c worksheet: a discovery request or a written request through counsel
On file in writing: the base, both multipliers and the ACV used
Assemble the answer: the appraisal, the supplement, the rental record; escalate to Atty. Thorne
Never make, accept, reject or counter **a PD figure** yourself

concepts.text: In suit, a Subpoena Duces Tecum **compels a non-party's records**; a blanket request invites a Motion to Quash
more: Goes out only once Atty. Thorne approves it
Narrow Exhibit A: patient, date, record types
Notice opposing counsel first, often 5–10 days (confirm the rule), **then serve the custodian**
Serve the custodian by process server; call to confirm compliance 5 days before production
Pay a custodian's invoice the day it arrives

framework.title: Calculating the Value of the Claim
head: Measure
How courts apply it
Its limit
rows: The lesser-of rule
The lesser of repair cost or the drop in market value
Costs more to fix than it was worth: a Total Loss
Diminished Value
Market value a car still loses after a proper repair
Many courts add it to repair, kept under pre-loss value
Special value
No market (an heirloom): some courts use actual value to the owner
Sentimental value is still excluded: **an exception, not the rule**
framework.note: Every measure starts from fair market value; confirm the governing rule with Atty. Thorne.

d5m3-l1.lead: A deposition can shape a litigated case's outcome: the attorney owns the legal strategy, while you prepare the client **operationally and psychologically**.

concepts.text: Before any prep meeting, review the file for **what the defense will exploit**, so Atty. Thorne meets it first
more: The 19-day disruption, 04/02 → 04/21/2026
The three 2021 low-back chiropractic visits
The seatbelt, and the “degenerative” MRI
Also John's signed interrogatory answers and public social media
Each tied to its source record and routed **before 02/04/2027**

concepts.text: The defense compares testimony with signed answers and records; any mismatch **reads as concealment**, so counsel sees it first
more: Alignment comes from reviewing the records with Atty. Thorne, **never a script**
Atty. Thorne decides whether an answer is corrected or supplemented
John testifies to the truth, never to match a document
Atty. Thorne chooses the review set: a document used to refresh memory may have to be produced
Never tell John to delete or hide a post

concepts.text: Clients expect a TV courtroom drama; showing **the real, ordinary process** calms them without any prediction
Defense counsel reports to the carrier how the client will strike a jury: **presentation feeds that report**

framework.title: Preparing Your Client for a Deposition

steps.label: Pre-deposition audit
steps.text: Prior medical history, signed answers, public social media: landmines routed to Atty. Thorne

steps.label: Pillar 1: De-escalate
steps.text: No judge, no jury, no shouting: calm the client with **the process**, never a prediction

steps.label: Pillar 2: Testimony guidelines
steps.text: Pause, tell the truth, stop once answered: drilled on neutral questions only

steps.label: Pillar 3: Dress and demeanor
steps.text: Business casual, nothing flashy; limitations told plainly, never minimized or exaggerated

steps.label: Technology check
steps.text: A computer, camera at eye level, light in front, a quiet private room

steps.label: The day before
steps.text: Confirm date, time and link with the client, Atty. Thorne and the court reporter

framework.note: Atty. Thorne prepares the substance; you prepare the person and the setting.

d5m3-l2.lead: The defense's goal is to make the client **contradict, lose temper or exaggerate**, damaging credibility; general rules protect it, a script cannot.

concepts.text: Defense counsel may ask a very broad range of questions to discover the facts: **wide questions are normal**, not attacks
more: Personal background: work, homes, earlier lawsuits
The crash mechanics
Medical history: this injury and anything before it
Daily life
Clients underreport medical history most; here, **the 2021 low-back visits**

concepts.text: An estimate rests on what you perceived; a guess claims what you couldn't know: **only the estimate** is honest testimony
A deposition gathers facts for the defense's evaluation; nothing is won there, so **the smallest target** protects the case
An objection is **a formal flag** on the record protecting the witness, not a sign of trouble
more: “Objection, form” is a routine flag on the record
John stops and lets the objection finish
Then he answers **unless Atty. Thorne instructs** him not to; often “You can answer”
The two-second pause leaves a window to object
Explain objections ahead of time so John doesn't freeze

framework.title: The 7 Golden Rules for Testifying
head: Rule
What it says
Why it protects
rows: Always tell the absolute truth
A damaged case can be saved; **a lied-about one cannot**
Pause two full seconds, then answer in words
Time to think, a clean transcript, a window to object
Never guess; answer only what was asked, then stop
“I don't know” is a complete answer: the smallest target
Hold the silence; don't try to win
A deposition gathers information; the legal battle is Atty. Thorne's
framework.note: Questions fall into four categories: background, crash mechanics, medical history, daily life. Clients underreport medical history most.

d5m4-l1.lead: Comparative negligence **apportions fault** between the parties; the share charged to the injured person can reduce, or bar, what they recover.

concepts.text: Pure, modified and contributory treat one fault finding differently: **the governing rule**, not the percentage alone, decides reduce or bar
more: Pure: damages fall by John's share, however large
Modified: damages fall, but recovery is barred at 50% in some states, 51% in others
Contributory, in a handful of jurisdictions: **any fault bars recovery**
John at 20%: recovers 80% everywhere except contributory
Confirm the governing rule; telling John his share of fault is never yours

concepts.text: Liability is accepted, partial or denied; recording **its status and source** shows Atty. Thorne what remains contested
Comparative fault concerns the crash; failure to mitigate concerns later care and **trims only avoidable damages**
more: Failure to mitigate targets 19 days without visits, 04/02 → 04/21/2026
The A-C-T record answers: the 04/08 call, extension refused 04/10, evening slots
Attendance resumed 04/21 and 04/23
Burden: **generally the defense's**; confirm the rule

concepts.text: An index answering each pleaded allegation with **evidence that can come in**, built for Atty. Thorne's analysis
more: One allegation, one row
Every item: its source, who can authenticate it, **its chain of custody**
Doorbell video: preservation asked 02/17/2026, copy secured 02/19/2026, native file unaltered, every transfer logged
Don't rest liability on report RPD-26-018842: its admissibility varies by state
No foundation, or a holder won't produce: flag it for a Subpoena Duces Tecum

d5m4-l2.lead: Filing a lawsuit **means nothing until service**: the defendant must be legally notified, or the case stalls and may be dismissed.

concepts.text: Defendants aware of a suit may hide, ignore the door or move; **diligent, logged attempts** prove the effort
A background search of utility, employment and address records that **finds a current address**, run only for permissible purpose
more: Run only on Atty. Thorne's authority, through the firm's licensed databases
Permissible purpose only: **no pretext calls**
Smith: three failed attempts at 118 Larkspur Ln; 10/09/2026 result, 4410 Quarry Ridge Ct, Millbrook
Pick the address on recency and two corroborating sources
A client's Skip-Trace has its own gate: ladder exhausted, Step 4 letter sent, its deadline passed, Atty. Thorne authorizes

concepts.text: A court-permitted substitute for personal service, such as mail or posting, that **only the attorney can request**
Certified mail leaves **a provable mailing record**; with email, it shows the client was told how to respond
more: The Step 4 Final Warning Letter: certified mail AND email, over Atty. Thorne's signature
Itemize the attempts; give a 7–14 day response date and how to respond
John's response date falls before the 02/04/2027 prep: **send by 01/27/2027**
Confirm the address before certified mail goes out
Withdrawal goes in only if Atty. Thorne directs it, in his words

framework.title: The Evading Defendant Protocol

steps.label: Attempts fail
steps.text: Log each attempt's date, time and address; follow up with the server every 5 days

steps.label: Skip-Trace
steps.text: On Atty. Thorne's authority, licensed databases check utility, employment and **active-address records**

steps.label: Vary the windows
steps.text: The server tries early mornings, evenings and weekends where the court's rules allow

steps.label: Alternative service
steps.text: Atty. Thorne may ask the court to permit service by mail or posting

steps.label: Proof of service
steps.text: The signed affidavit of service is filed with the court, never left in email

framework.note: Unserved before the court's deadline, a case can be dismissed: confirm the court's rule.

d5m6-l1.lead: A Dropped Case is a claim **discontinued before resolution**: documented, closed out and proved, so the client is informed and the firm is protected.

concepts.text: Unresponsive client, no liability, no coverage, unfinished treatment such as **no Health Plan**, or conflicting information
more: Whether any reason ends a case is **Atty. Thorne's decision**
An unresponsive client arrives here only through the No Contact Protocol and its Final Warning Letter
Then Atty. Thorne chooses a Notice of Withdrawal or, in a filed suit, a Motion to Withdraw

concepts.text: A formal notice that **the attorney-client relationship has ended**, directing the client to seek other counsel
more: One for the client and for every carrier and provider on the file
From the firm's template, over Atty. Thorne's signature
Each carries the date, client name, date of loss and claim number
Saved in Word and PDF
Only the client's carries **the reason**, in Atty. Thorne's words, and the next step he approves

concepts.text: The status that says the decision is made; the letters wait until **the client has been told**
Certified Mail receipts, dispatch logs and saved letters **protect the firm** if the drop is questioned later
more: Log each dispatch: party, method and date
Follow up the return receipt, the carrier's acknowledgement, the fax confirmation
A time-sensitive party gets a call
Then switch the status to Dropped; **keep the proof**: letters, receipts, logs, Atty. Thorne's note

d5m5-l1.lead: The Net Sheet is **the ultimate transparency tool**: it shows the client where every dollar came from and where it goes.

more: The reduction follows **the fee actually charged**: 40% on this file

Fees can differ by stream and stage; tracking **each stream's fee separately** keeps the ledger accurate and explainable
more: Suit filed 09/24/2026, so **the 40% tier** applies: $16,000.00 on $40,000.00
Atty. Thorne confirms each stream's fee from the retainer before the Net Sheet is drafted
Show John the tier in his own retainer
Track A, settled before suit, charged 33⅓%: never carry it into this file

d5m1-subp.lead: Litigation runs on **court-commanded evidence**: a subpoena makes a non-party produce records or a witness appear, and a careless one gets quashed.

concepts.text: Commands a non-party to **produce documents** when a hospital, cell provider or employer won't do it voluntarily
more: “Duces tecum” means bring it with you: a command to produce documents
Drafted on the court-approved form: case style, target entity, production date, and a precise Exhibit A
Served by process server on the facility's **Registered Agent** or records custodian
Goes out only once Atty. Thorne decides, signs and issues it

concepts.text: Compels a witness to appear and testify, so fact witnesses, treating physicians and officers **legally show up**
more: Drafted only for the witnesses **Atty. Thorne names**
This file's candidates: Ruth Calloway, Officer Thomas Garner #2217, Dr. Alana Reyes, Dr. Helen Park
Tasked against pretrial 08/12/2027 and the 09/13/2027 trial calendar
Service, timing and any witness fee: confirm the court's rules

concepts.text: A blanket “all records” request is **a fishing expedition**; the defense or the third party moves to quash
more: The deck's model wording, narrowed three ways:
“Any and all emergency room records, triage notes, and radiological imaging regarding [Client] for the treatment date of [Accident Date] only.”
One subject, an exact date range, **named record types**
Narrow is also faster: a custodian can comply with a request it can read

concepts.text: Draft, notice opposing counsel, serve the custodian, track compliance: **notice comes first**, often 5–10 days before
more: Draft on the court-approved form
Notice to opposing counsel before the third party; confirm **the governing rule**
Formal service by process server on the Registered Agent
Compliance call to the records or legal department 5 days before the deadline
Pay the custodian's copy invoice promptly; an unpaid invoice delays production
